## Repository change

Public concrete-matroid and infinite-family submissions belong in the GitHub
Issue Forms, not in pull requests.

- [ ] Website, verifier, workflow, documentation, or curator-approved data
      change
- [ ] Tests or reproducible analysis change

## Summary

Describe the repository change and its scope.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran the relevant tests or documented why they do not apply.
- [ ] I did not add executable code supplied through a public submission.
- [ ] Any mathematical claim is accompanied by a proof, an exact certificate,
      or a precise reference.
